def diff_summary(before, after):
    b = before.ascii.split('\n'); a = after.ascii.split('\n')
    changed = []
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c in range(len(a[r])):
            if b[r][c] != a[r][c]:
                changed.append((r, c, b[r][c], a[r][c]))
    return changed

print("result:", {k: v for k, v in res.items() if k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','reward','score')})

res = action(['LEFT'])
d = diff_summary(previous_frame, current_frame)
core = [x for x in d if x[1] < 62]

def diff_summary(before, after):
    b = before.ascii.split('\n'); a = after.ascii.split('\n')
    changed = []
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c in range(len(a[r])):
            if b[r][c] != a[r][c]:
                changed.append((r, c, b[r][c], a[r][c]))
    return changed
